questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones ahead. This sign tells you to expect construction and to slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead and you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a low ground railroad crossing. The tracks cross at a steep slope, and low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is ahead and you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign means parking is not permitted at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a Y intersection is ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, it points left. You may see several of these signs placed along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection pass first. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops when signals are broken or to help other drivers. A left arm bent at the elbow pointing upward means a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drifts onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply to get back on the road. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overhead bridge or overpass ahead. Do not drive through if your vehicle is taller than the height listed on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming up. Watch carefully for traffic crossing from other directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is ahead. Slow down when entering and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs indicate railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When driving on a multi-lane road, make space for vehicles entering the road. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles often cross or travel near traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, following riders should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and let other traffic go first. You can proceed when it is safe.
